steps.message: Repair /app/csv.mjs. Export parseCSV(text), returning rows of string fields. Support commas, LF and CRLF record endings, quoted fields containing commas/newlines, escaped double quotes represented as two double quotes, empty fields, and a final record without a newline. A trailing record separator must not add an extra empty row. Empty input returns []. Reject an unclosed quoted field with SyntaxError. Inputs are well-formed otherwise. Preserve spaces within fields. You may add local tests. Use no dependencies or network access.
